I went to primary school, so I can read the labels on the fertilizer bags, and I know my sandy soil in Lindi needs feeding if the maize is to grow. Last season I put one 50-kilogram bag of urea on each hectare and spread manure from my goats before planting, and the crop was better than the year before, so I will do exactly that again. I will buy improved OPV seed from the dealer because it is not as costly as hybrid and I can keep some of the harvest for seed. My family will put in about 220 days of work on this plot over the season, and I will hire labor for 15 days when the weeds are bad, but I do not have money for chemicals or irrigation.
